headline: American Tower Q2 AFFO Meets Estimates, Revenues Beat, '26 View Up
summary: AMT's Q2 AFFO comes in line with estimates as revenues top expectations, fueled by tower leasing and data center growth. A higher 2026 outlook signals momentum.
